note: A first tune on one string, played from the tab with the app: Do, Re, Mi and back (tune 2 of the book). The key is moves (any key) and the tempo too, so the text names no selector and its one line about another key opens with {{?key}} and says what stays the same: the climb and the way back.

exercise.title: Up three notes and back
exercise.why: This tune climbs three notes and comes back down the same way, all on one string, so your hand learns to move up a string as well as down it.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune, then play along from the tab, one note per beat. The tune is all on one string: from {{1}} up to {{3}}, and back down to {{1}}.
Practice until you can hum the tune before you play it.
{{?key}}In another key the tune starts on another fret, and it still climbs to {{3}} and comes back down the same way.
